_doc: GX1 terrain conformance (docs/graphics-overhaul.md#gx1-terrain-conformance). Every deformation here is derived from the placed instances (no map data), so all clients compute the same ground. Lengths in metres, angles in degrees.

placement._doc: Auto-levelling pads (brief §6). A pinned object (building, bunker, emplacement with a footprint) stands on the median of its footprint samples; the ground under the footprint is raised or lowered to that level and blended into the surroundings over a smoothstep ring. Placement is refused when the ground varies more than `margin` from the level.
placement._doc_soil: packed soil shown on raised / cut ground next to the pad (dirt mask, 0..1) at 1 m of change, fading to grass at the ring edge

earthwork._doc: Bunker earth banks as terrain stamps (brief §5): crest heights from the asset's `earthwork` block, an angle-of-repose profile (convex shoulder, concave toe), low-frequency noise, and a smoothing band past the toe. Slope-driven soil mask: bare above `bareSlope`, sparse grass from `sparseSlope`.

trench._doc: Trench carve along the pieces' joined paths (brief §7). depth = floor below the anchor (the parapet crest adds parapetHeight, so lip to floor is depth + parapet), floor width = 2 x floorHalf, the walls lean back by `batter` (horizontal per vertical). The parapet (spoil) is raised either side within parapetWidth of the lip.
